origin.author: jmeter-rs project
origin.description: Hand-authored bounded JMX for JMeter random, date/time, counter, scope, and undefined-expansion contracts. Fixed domains and explicit descriptors prevent fabricated random/current-time output.

license.repository_notice: LICENSE and NOTICE at repository root
license.upstream_distribution_use: Apache JMeter 5.6.3 is the pinned external oracle for a later run; no upstream plan, result, source, or binary is redistributed.

profile_digest_verification.verification_basis: The profile records a SHA-512-only check. This static case did not fetch, unpack, or execute the artifact; PGP verification remains a future runner gate.

locale_evidence.verification: Record the materialized target-OS locale and Locale.getDefault().toLanguageTag(); fail evidence promotion if either is absent or differs from en-US.

timezone_evidence.verification: Launch with -Duser.timezone=UTC and record System.getProperty("user.timezone"); do not infer the JVM zone from TZ alone.

charset_evidence.verification: Record System.getProperty("file.encoding") and Charset.defaultCharset().name(); fail evidence promotion if either is absent or differs from UTF-8.

jvm_charset_requirement.verification: A future oracle runner must verify file.encoding, Charset.defaultCharset(), user.timezone, and the effective JVM locale before comparing output; this static corpus does not infer any observation from process settings.

runtime.hostname_policy: not asserted; hostname saving disabled and no host function is in the materialized plan
runtime.jmeter_classpath: not executed; future runs must use the profile-pinned Apache JMeter 5.6.3 distribution (SHA-512 checked; PGP verification required before oracle use)

process_lifecycle.wait_reap: Wait and reap the exact launcher/Java child on success, error, timeout, and cancellation; never select a process by name or stale PID.

runner_materialization.resolution: Resolve placeholders only from an allowlisted runner manifest after the profile artifact digest gate; inherited PATH lookup and shell interpolation are forbidden.

random_source.seed_control: Neither source is fixture-seedable through a supported JMeter 5.6.3 option; exact values are not claimed except for degenerate domains or shape contracts.

determinism.clock: UTC JVM timezone is required for exact epoch date/time forms; __time remains ambient wall-clock and descriptor-normalized, while dateTimeConvert/timeShift non-ambient inputs are fixed
determinism.locale: Requested process/JVM locale is en-US and explicit date-function locale is en_US; effective launcher/JVM observations remain pending

sources.coverage: Random, RandomDate, RandomFromMultipleVars, RandomString, UUID, counter, time, timeShift, dateTimeConvert, and expansion rules
5.6.3 ThreadLocalRandom domains for Random/RandomDate/RandomFromMultipleVars/RandomString, UUID.randomUUID delegation, RandomDate end-exclusive range, and function implementations

evidence.expectations_are: hand-authored planned constraints, later-consumed variable/phase contracts, and exact stable JTL projections; no observed Apache output
